monstera.name: Monstera
monstera.notes: Water when the top 5 cm of soil is dry and give it a moss pole to climb.

pothos.name: Pothos
pothos.notes: Let the top half of the soil dry out between waterings; droopy leaves mean it's thirsty.

peace_lily.name: Peace lily
peace_lily.notes: Keep the soil lightly moist; it wilts dramatically when dry and perks up within hours of watering.

snake_plant.name: Snake plant
snake_plant.notes: Water only when the soil is fully dry, every 2 to 4 weeks; overwatering rots the roots.

zz_plant.name: ZZ plant
zz_plant.notes: Water sparingly, every 2 to 3 weeks; its thick rhizomes store water and rot in soggy soil.

fiddle_leaf_fig.name: Fiddle leaf fig
fiddle_leaf_fig.notes: Give it bright light and a steady spot; it drops leaves when moved or left in a draft.

rubber_plant.name: Rubber plant
rubber_plant.notes: Water when the top few cm are dry and wipe the leaves so they keep their shine.

spider_plant.name: Spider plant
spider_plant.notes: Keep evenly moist in spring and summer; brown tips usually mean hard tap water or dry air.

heartleaf_philodendron.name: Heartleaf philodendron
heartleaf_philodendron.notes: Water when the top 3 cm are dry; trim long vines to keep it bushy.

chinese_evergreen.name: Chinese evergreen
chinese_evergreen.notes: Happy in low light; let the top of the soil dry and keep it away from cold drafts.

dracaena.name: Dracaena
dracaena.notes: Water when the top half of the soil is dry; it is sensitive to fluoride in tap water.

calathea.name: Calathea
calathea.notes: Keep the soil just moist and the air humid; filtered or rain water avoids crispy edges.

prayer_plant.name: Prayer plant
prayer_plant.notes: Keep the soil lightly moist and out of direct sun, which fades its patterned leaves.

boston_fern.name: Boston fern
boston_fern.notes: Never let it dry out completely and mist it often; it sheds fronds in dry air.

maidenhair_fern.name: Maidenhair fern
maidenhair_fern.notes: Keep the soil constantly moist and the air humid; a bathroom with a window suits it well.

birds_nest_fern.name: Bird's nest fern
birds_nest_fern.notes: Water around the soil, not into the central rosette, and keep the air humid.

staghorn_fern.name: Staghorn fern
staghorn_fern.notes: Soak the root ball when it feels light and dry, roughly weekly in summer.

kentia_palm.name: Kentia palm
kentia_palm.notes: Water when the top 5 cm are dry; it copes with lower light better than most palms.

parlor_palm.name: Parlor palm
parlor_palm.notes: Keep the soil lightly moist and out of direct sun; a great pick for shadier rooms.

areca_palm.name: Areca palm
areca_palm.notes: Keep the soil evenly moist but never soggy and give it bright, filtered light.

ponytail_palm.name: Ponytail palm
ponytail_palm.notes: Water deeply but rarely; its swollen trunk stores water for weeks.

aloe_vera.name: Aloe vera
aloe_vera.notes: Water thoroughly only when the soil is completely dry and give it a sunny sill.

jade_plant.name: Jade plant
jade_plant.notes: Let the soil dry out between waterings; red leaf edges are a sign of healthy sun.

echeveria.name: Echeveria
echeveria.notes: Give it as much sun as you can and a gritty mix; water only when the soil is bone dry.

haworthia.name: Haworthia
haworthia.notes: Copes with less sun than most succulents; water when dry, and less in winter.

string_of_pearls.name: String of pearls
string_of_pearls.notes: Water when the pearls look slightly wrinkled and keep it in a shallow, free-draining pot.

christmas_cactus.name: Christmas cactus
christmas_cactus.notes: Unlike desert cacti it likes lightly moist soil; cool autumn nights trigger flowers.

bunny_ear_cactus.name: Bunny ear cactus
bunny_ear_cactus.notes: Full sun and very little water; keep it dry and cool in winter for spring growth.

golden_barrel_cactus.name: Golden barrel cactus
golden_barrel_cactus.notes: Give it your sunniest window and water about monthly in summer, hardly at all in winter.

moon_cactus.name: Moon cactus
moon_cactus.notes: Bright light without harsh midday sun; water only when the soil is completely dry.

moth_orchid.name: Moth orchid
moth_orchid.notes: Water when the roots turn silvery, about weekly, and let the pot drain fully.

anthurium.name: Anthurium
anthurium.notes: Water when the top few cm are dry and keep the air humid for steady flowers.

african_violet.name: African violet
african_violet.notes: Water from below with room-temperature water and keep drops off the fuzzy leaves.

bromeliad.name: Bromeliad
bromeliad.notes: Keep a little water in the central cup and refresh it every week or two.

begonia.name: Begonia
begonia.notes: Water when the top of the soil is dry and keep the leaves dry to prevent mildew.

kalanchoe.name: Kalanchoe
kalanchoe.notes: Treat it like a succulent: plenty of light and water only when the soil is dry.

hoya.name: Hoya
hoya.notes: Let it dry out between waterings and don't move it once flower buds form.

string_of_hearts.name: String of hearts
string_of_hearts.notes: Water when the soil is dry; more sun gives deeper colour and tighter leaves.

tradescantia.name: Tradescantia
tradescantia.notes: Keep lightly moist in bright light for the strongest colour; pinch the tips to keep it full.

english_ivy.name: English ivy
english_ivy.notes: Prefers cool rooms; keep the soil lightly moist and watch for spider mites in dry air.

bird_of_paradise.name: Bird of paradise
bird_of_paradise.notes: Needs very bright light with some direct sun to thrive; water when the top 5 cm are dry.

alocasia.name: Alocasia
alocasia.notes: Keep the soil lightly moist and the air humid; it may drop leaves and rest in winter.

cast_iron_plant.name: Cast iron plant
cast_iron_plant.notes: Almost indestructible: low light and occasional watering suit it fine.

pilea.name: Chinese money plant
pilea.notes: Turn it weekly so it grows straight and water when the top half of the soil is dry.

basil.name: Basil
basil.notes: Give it your sunniest window and keep the soil moist; pinch the tops to stop it flowering.

mint.name: Mint
mint.notes: Keep it moist and give it its own pot; it spreads fast and loves a bright spot.

parsley.name: Parsley
parsley.notes: Keep the soil evenly moist and cut the outer stems first so it keeps growing.

rosemary.name: Rosemary
rosemary.notes: Needs lots of sun and a fairly dry pot; overwatering is the usual way to lose it.

thyme.name: Thyme
thyme.notes: Sun and sharp drainage; water only when the top of the soil is dry.

chives.name: Chives
chives.notes: Keep moist in a sunny spot and snip leaves near the base to keep them coming.
